steps: Use a disposable checkout matching the chosen source hashes. Set an external PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX and disable pytest cache.

Source replacement helpers require the target to occur exactly once. A missing target or other setup failure is not credited as red proof. Function substitutions modify the actual production entry points used by the tests.

source_reuse_note: Earlier witnesses remain bound to their recorded snapshots. The final control exercises current tests after all changes. Changed attempt parsing, native metadata selection and schema guards receive four new targeted fault witnesses; no blanket claim reruns earlier snapshots.

runtime_known_after_tightening.purpose: Re-ran the runtime-known fault after tightening lane-specific tmux requirements.

unapplied_attempts.reason: Initial source target did not match exactly once. Excluded from detection evidence; corrected exact output-expression replacement was then executed and is the credited fault above.

limits: HTTP responses are controlled in API tests; origin checks, bounded reads, ZIP digest verification, actual extraction, candidate lineage, static qualification and full aggregate evaluation execute normally.
Hosted credential/event delivery, concurrency and platform required-check association are separate acceptance evidence.
No exception/setup/import failure is counted as an intended detection. Healthy controls and assertion excerpts identify the executed contract boundaries.

review_repairs_attempt_history.scope: Two pre-draft review repairs: equal attempt-start cohorts must not hide a material or unknown peer; a cancelled zero-job retry does not establish that all earlier attempts never executed. The neutral-shortcut run reread also detects a retry appearing after the run list.

regressions.after: Unresolved same-start peers produce execute/ambiguous evidence rather than an older-green reuse claim.

regressions.before: Attempt two was classified never-executed from its zero latest jobs.
regressions.after: Only positively proven first-attempt zero-job metadata can use that neutral shortcut.

regressions.before: The latest cancelled attempt hid an earlier failed behavioral job and reused the old green producer.
regressions.after: The HTTP fixture returns jobs for the requested attempt; all-attempt history remains material and validation executes.

regressions.before: A stale cancelled attempt-one list entry stayed neutral after the authoritative run advanced to failed attempt two.
regressions.after: The authoritative run reread prevents the stale neutral assertion.

regressions.after: The original executed aggregate and artifact remain attempt one while fresh observation IDs and attempt two remain visible; stored observation claims remain historical.

regressions.before: A copied CI-result wrapper also blocked an otherwise qualified one-hop summary.
regressions.after: The summary retains its own actual-one/observed-two aggregate identity while the full original producer remains independently identified.

historical_observation_guard_witness.intended_assertion: Both forged historical observation ID/attempt cases failed with DID NOT RAISE ValueError while three healthy native-copy controls still passed. Normalization alone cannot erase the historical observation authentication requirement.

review_repairs_native_aggregate_copies.fixture_details: Native HTTP records include run/head/runner identity, original timestamps and complete step data. Copied observations receive new IDs/attempt numbers and later creation times but preserve the original execution signature. Actual aggregate retries change execution timestamps and require their own artifact.
